notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.7
notes.content:
[h2]Minor improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] A control guide was added at the bottom right corner.
[*] You can now better see where the wall or furniture will be placed.
[*] Added descriptions for blueprint items.
[*] Reduced the volume of Gadie’s voice slightly.
[*] Notifications now appear when tool upgrades are complete.
[/list]


[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed damage not displaying when mining rocks.
[*] Fixed an issue where furniture could be placed on doors.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the wall when you restart the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game couldn’t be restarted after saving during dialogue.
[*] Fixed an issue where the furnace output would disappear if you picked it up consecutively.
[*] Fixed an issue with duplicate recipes for the buffet.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.6
notes.content:
[h2]Minor Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an emergency escape button to the question mark button in the bottom-right corner.
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can no longer destroy the buffet while it contains food.
[*] Furniture and rocks can now be destroyed using an iron pickaxe.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.5
notes.content:
[h2]Minor Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a simple input guide to the question mark button in the bottom-right corner.
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the item tooltip was not visible in the bottom hotbar.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could not be continued if the player exited immediately after starting a new game.
[*] Fixed an issue where items would disappear when picked up when the backpack was full.
[/list]
